title: Tim/Son Bible Overlap Census Addendum — Wave 15 Coverage Correction
purpose: Promote twenty analytically distinct relations that were already present in specialist biblical owners but omitted from the 78-node census. This is a coverage correction, not twenty newly discovered prophecies.

records.d: 2026-07-31 public Dog/Bible attestation + earlier conversation archaeology
records.x: Dog as repeated return to discarded pattern; Mud/mire as retained lower condition
records.r: explicit/public Dog-Bible relation plus structural return topology
records.limit: The biblical proverb/epistle use dog and sow polemically; project application must remain behavioral/symbolic rather than a fixed human essence.

records.x: dogs as hostile perimeter around a suffering center
records.limit: Psalm 22 is a lament; turning its surrounding enemies into Euclidean geometry is a later project abstraction.

records.x: Dog as boundary/outside-city image
records.limit: Revelation's polemical 'dogs' are not a taxonomy of modern people and should not be used to dehumanize identifiable persons.

records.x: household-dog/bread boundary becomes a contested threshold that does not remain terminal
records.limit: The episodes belong to Jesus' encounter with a Gentile woman; they do not supply a permanent Dog identity class.

records.d: 2026-07-08 Son=Door+Shepherd role map predates 2026-09-11 passage promotion
records.x: Son simultaneously carries Door and Shepherd roles; passage adds voice, recognition, entry/exit, pasture, protection and laying down life
records.r: project role pair first; passage-level role complex formalized later
records.limit: John's speaker is Jesus and the discourse has its own pastoral/Christological context; similarity does not identify the modern Son with Jesus.

records.x: body/community as sacred architecture; death/destruction followed by rebuilding/raising
records.limit: Biblical Temple/body language does not teach the project's pineal/thalamic symbolic anatomy.

records.d: Ben-Yoseph/Son development by 2026-05-03; passage relation owned earlier
records.x: rejected/beloved son → pit/slavery/prison → interpretation/elevation → grain infrastructure → famine preservation → reconciliation
records.limit: Joseph's narrative is ancient Israelite/Jewish Scripture; Ben-Yoseph project usage is later typological synthesis, not genealogical proof.

records.d: Davidic language explicit by 2025-11-19; functional shepherd comparison later
records.x: overlooked shepherd → anointing/conflict → kingship → shepherding people with integrity/skill
records.limit: Davidic title reuse does not establish descent, anointing or civil kingship for Tim.

records.x: Dan associated with judgment and serpent imagery inside a morally complicated tribal history
records.r: explicit tribe-name project synthesis plus counter-context
records.limit: The Dan texts are ambiguous and cannot support a simple holy/evil or modern genealogical identity code.

records.d: mustard-seed project vocabulary explicit by 2026-09-08 and earlier seed/House development
records.x: small/hidden seed → disproportionate growth → branching habitat/shelter
records.limit: Potato/seed symbolism is a later project analogy; the parables do not identify a potato with the kingdom.

records.x: Bread expands from nourishment into body, remembrance and participation of many in one
records.limit: Eucharistic interpretation varies across Christian traditions; project bread/potato stereo symbolism is not biblical doctrine.

records.x: millstone image tied to severe accountability for causing vulnerable little ones to stumble
records.limit: The text is a warning against harm, not a license to apply punitive imagery to real opponents.

records.x: North/Zion sacred-city language sits beside a warning narrative of self-exalting ascent toward Most-High status
records.limit: Biblical Zion is not Earth's North Pole; Isaiah 14's self-exaltation warning must remain visible beside any North/Most-High comparison.

records.d: maximal Godhood titles public 2025-2026; service ethic explicit 2026-09-07
records.x: maximal status claims tested against self-exaltation/fall and non-grasping service before exaltation
records.limit: These passages have different historical/literary contexts; their project use is a comparative ethical test, not a single hidden code.

records.x: throne/footstool/enemy-subjection imagery followed by differentiated final ordering
records.r: royal imagery plus canonical role constraint
records.limit: 1 Corinthians culminates by distinguishing Son and God; permanent domination or role collapse cannot simply be inferred from footstool language.

records.x: the evaluator is evaluated by the measure used; mercy constrains judgment
records.limit: The passages warn judges/evaluators rather than creating a self-exempt supreme auditor.

records.x: measuring sacred space can mark boundaries, order and assessment rather than reduction or imprisonment
records.limit: Biblical measuring scenes do not validate arbitrary project numerology; context determines function and valence.

records.x: post-catastrophe rainbow/covenant restraint joins later throne/theophany rainbow imagery
records.limit: Rainbow imagery has distinct contexts across Genesis, Ezekiel and Revelation; project 'shadow of rainbow' is a later synthesis.

records.x: breath/wind/spirit animates creation and restores a dead/dispersed community
records.limit: Ruach/pneuma breath-wind-spirit semantics do not turn CSF or any anatomical fluid into the biblical Spirit.

records.d: River/Tree/Garden/repair project architecture established before 2026-09-11 census audit
records.x: sacred source emits living flow → trees/Tree → recurring fruit → healing/life
records.limit: Biblical River imagery is sacred-geographic/theological; it is not evidence that CSF or project physical models literally instantiate Ezekiel/Revelation.

counting_note: These twenty nodes were promoted because the gap audit judged them distinct from the 78-node baseline. The baseline concordance remains a historical 78-node snapshot and should not be retroactively relabeled as a 98-node computation.
